name: jungle_ruin
_about: Level 2 Jungle Ruins: peach dusk, cool sage jungle, warm ochre limestone and a quiet earth road.
Build with scripts/build_layer_set.py. Layer order is draw order; ground precedes the ruins.
Sources and generation sidecars live in build/art/jungle_ruin/. Prompt history is archived in art/prompts/jungle_ruin/.
All generations used gemini-3.1-flash-image at 4:1, 4K, without references. No seam waivers or feathering.
The first clouds repeated internally; clouds_v2 uses six distinct silhouettes. Preserve its intentional empty x margins.
The first far band repeated or painted a sky. far_v2 variant 2 keys cleanly and wraps without cutting artwork.
Ground revisions removed outlined patches and literal margin panels. ground_v3 variant 2 is the keeper.
mid variant 2 received one mid_refine turn to remove an interior magenta stain. Remeasure geometry after regeneration.

layers.name: sky
layers._source: sky.txt variant 2, cropped to [250, 0, 8000, 2048]. The first passing cut retained a visible interior margin panel; this tighter crop removes both panels and still wraps at 0.00/0.00 with no flattening or feathering.

layers.name: clouds
layers._source: clouds_v2.txt variant 1; cut_layer auto key --low 0.20 --no-crop, then trim rows to alpha > 2. Keep empty side margins; 8256x735, ambiguous 0.34%.

layers.name: far
layers._source: far_v2.txt variant 2; cut_layer auto key --low 0.20 --no-crop, trim rows to alpha > 2 and one empty column from either edge; 8254x1713, ambiguous 0.94%.
layers._overlap: Bottom at 0.57 overlaps the floor's top at 0.54. Tops remain visible between near ruins as their scroll phases separate.

layers.name: ground
layers._geometry: The top edge at 0.54 is inside the refined ruin bank's measured opaque span, 0.504-0.586; 100% of columns cover the edge. Units and ruins share this floor's scroll rate.

layers.name: mid
layers._source: mid.txt variant 2, followed by mid_refine.txt; cut_layer auto key --low 0.20 with default crop and erosion. Ambiguous 0.80%. Then make_tileable --width 8000 --tolerance 0.03 --no-flatten --feather 0: x=13, width=8236, raw edge cost 0.60/255.
layers._geometry: Near stone feet at 0.65, just above the 0.66-0.79 combat band. A shallow floor-coloured contact shadow seats the bank without a dark rule.
